title: Doug Alt: the portal is real

tellings.quote: says, "Remember that question you asked me a couple years ago?" I said, "Yeah, it's real." >> Who said that? >> Doug Al. He said, "It's real."

plain: A man named Doug Alt once told the UFO researcher Grant Cameron that a portal Cameron had asked him about was real. Cameron says Alt came back to him years later, asked "Remember that question you asked me a couple years ago?", and then said "It's real." Cameron passes this on secondhand, in a conversation that also involves a government scientist named Ron Pandolfi, and he does not say much more about what the portal is.
